# dj-hx

> Handler-first htmx 4 for Django. The view names the outcome with a verb (`render`, `page`, `fragment`,
> `invalid`, `redirect`, `removed`, `text`); the template keeps every request-side control; fragments are
> `{% partialdef %}` regions of the page template. Nothing depends on django-htmx. Every way htmx 4 fails
> silently is turned into a raised or recorded error with a message that says what to change.

Facts to hold while writing code against this package:

- Requires htmx **4** (`HX-Request-Type` header). htmx 1/2 idioms are rejected by a lint that runs on every
  test-client response. Django 4.2 to 6.0, Python 3.10+.
- The only client fact a handler reads is `HX-Request-Type`: `full` (browser, boosted link, or a control
  whose target is `body` or that sets `hx-select`) or `partial` (a control targeting an element). Never
  read `HX-Source` or `HX-Target`; never branch on an element id.
- One template per resource. A fragment is a named `{% partialdef name inline %}` region of that page
  template. A partial name containing a dot (`rows.html`) is a separate file instead.
- Any partial delivered as an `<hx-partial>` (`.partial("count")`, the messages partial) must have exactly
  one root element whose `id` equals the partial's name.
- Verbs *raise* when the mistake is certain at call time. Everything else is *recorded* on
  `response.hx_findings`, logged to the `dj_hx` logger, and raised by `HxTestClient`. Production never 500s
  on a recorded finding.

## Install

```python
INSTALLED_APPS = [..., "django.contrib.messages", "dj_hx", ...]

MIDDLEWARE = [
    ...,
    "django.middleware.common.CommonMiddleware",
    "django.contrib.messages.middleware.MessageMiddleware",
    "dj_hx.middleware.HxMiddleware",          # AFTER MessageMiddleware (check dj_hx.E002)
]

HX_MESSAGES_TEMPLATE = "layout.html#messages"  # flash messages bridged into fragment responses
```

Django 4.2 to 5.x has no `{% partialdef %}`; install `django-template-partials` and register its tags
as a builtin (or every template must `{% load partials %}`). Django 6.0 needs none of this:

```python
import django
if django.VERSION < (6, 0):
    INSTALLED_APPS.insert(0, "template_partials")
    TEMPLATES[0]["OPTIONS"]["builtins"] = ["template_partials.templatetags.partials"]
```

Layout. In htmx 4 an attribute reaches descendants only with `:inherited`; a bare `hx-boost="true"` on
`<body>` boosts nothing. The CSRF header rides on every htmx request this way, including query-string
DELETEs. The messages partial is a `partialdef` so a fragment response can update it too.

```django
{% load static %}<!doctype html>
<html><head><script src="{% static 'js/htmx-4.0.0.js' %}"></script></head>
<body hx-boost:inherited="true" hx-headers:inherited='{"X-CSRFToken": "{{ csrf_token }}"}'>
{% partialdef messages inline %}
<div id="messages">{% for message in messages %}<div class="flash">{{ message }}</div>{% endfor %}</div>
{% endpartialdef %}
{% block content %}{% endblock %}
</body></html>
```

Template context processors must include `django.template.context_processors.request` and
`django.contrib.messages.context_processors.messages`.

## Choosing the verb

| The handler's outcome | Write |
|---|---|
| Same URL serves the page to a browser and one region to a control | `render(request, "index.html", "rows", ctx)` |
| Always the whole page (a detail or edit page) | `page(request, "show.html", ctx)` |
| Always a fragment: a polling widget, a region never served as a page | `fragment(request, "archive_ui.html", context=ctx)` or `fragment(request, "index.html", "rows", ctx)` |
| Form failed validation | `invalid(request, "new.html", "form", ctx)` (status 422; htmx 4 swaps it) |
| Success; the browser or a body-targeted control should land elsewhere | `redirect(request, "contacts", pk=3)` (plain 303) |
| Resource deleted; the control says `hx-swap="delete"` | `removed(request)` (200, empty body) |
| A short string into a span or an error slot | `text(request, "(3 total)")` (HTML-escaped) |
| One URL reached by both a body-targeted control and an element-targeted one | branch on `wants_page(request)` |

Never return `HttpResponse(status=204)`, `HttpResponseRedirect`, `django.shortcuts.redirect`,
`django.shortcuts.render` or `HttpResponse("")` to an htmx request. Say what happened with a verb: a
response no verb built that answers an element-targeted request is recorded as `HxBareResponse`.

## API

Everything below is importable from `dj_hx`.

### Request side

```python
is_htmx(request) -> bool            # HX-Request: true
request_type(request) -> str|None   # "full" | "partial" | None (a browser)
wants_page(request) -> bool         # browser, boosted link, or body-targeted control
wants_fragment(request) -> bool     # a control targeting an element
current_url(request) -> str|None    # HX-Current-URL
vary_on_hx(response) -> response    # Vary: HX-Request, HX-Request-Type (the verbs and middleware do this)
```

An htmx request without `HX-Request-Type` raises `HxProtocolError` (this needs htmx 4). A proxy that strips
the header can be worked around with `HX_REQUEST_TYPE_FALLBACK = "full"` or `"partial"`; the guard still
records the finding.

### Verbs

```python
render(request, template, partial, context=None, *, status=200) -> HxResponse
    # wants_page: the page. Otherwise: the partial of `template` (or the file if `partial` has a dot).

page(request, template, context=None) -> HxResponse
    # Always the page. RAISES HxPageIntoFragment on a partial request.

fragment(request, template, partial=None, context=None) -> HxResponse
    # Always a fragment: the file `template`, or `partial` of it. RECORDS HxFragmentIntoPage
    # when a boosted or body-targeted htmx request would put a bare fragment into <body>.

invalid(request, template, partial, context=None) -> HxResponse
    # render() with status 422. No client configuration needed; htmx 4 swaps 422 bodies.

redirect(request, to, *args, code=303, **kwargs) -> HxRedirectResponse
    # `to` resolves like django.shortcuts.redirect (URL name, model, or URL).
    # RAISES HxRedirectIntoFragment on a partial request (fetch would follow it into the element).

removed(request) -> HxResponse
    # 200 with an empty body. The control's hx-swap="delete" removes its own representation.

text(request, value) -> HxResponse
    # str(value), HTML-escaped. RECORDS HxFragmentIntoPage on a full htmx request.
```

Every verb sets `Vary`. Under `DEBUG` the response carries `X-HX-Template: index.html#rows`.

### Response methods

`HxResponse` (an `HttpResponse`) and `HxRedirectResponse` (a 303) share these; all return `self`:

```python
.trigger(name, *, target="body", **detail)   # HX-Trigger, always JSON, always with a target
.partial(name, template=None)                # append <hx-partial hx-target="#name" hx-swap="outerHTML">
                                             # rendered from the page template with the same context;
                                             # only on fragment responses (no-op on a page); root id checked
.push_url(url) / .replace_url(url)           # HX-Push-Url / HX-Replace-Url
.with_status(code)
.retarget(selector) / .reswap(spec)          # escape hatches: the template can no longer predict the
                                             # DOM effect. Use with a comment saying why.
```

`.trigger()` always sets a `target` because after a `delete` swap the requesting element is gone and htmx 4
would dispatch on `document`, where an `hx-trigger="x from:body"` listener cannot hear it. `detail` keys are
unpacked into the scope of `hx-on` handlers.

```python
return render(request, "index.html", "rows", ctx).trigger("contacts-changed")
return fragment(request, "index.html", "rows", ctx).partial("count")   # also refreshes #count
```

### Generic views

```python
from dj_hx import HxMixin

class ContactList(HxMixin, ListView):          # HxMixin FIRST (check dj_hx.E007)
    model = Contact
    template_name = "index.html"
    partial = "rows"                            # None means page() only, which raises on a partial request

class ContactCreate(HxMixin, CreateView):
    model = Contact
    fields = ["first", "last", "email"]
    template_name = "new.html"
    partial = "form"
    success_url = reverse_lazy("contacts")
```

`HxMixin` overrides three hooks: `render_to_response` (goes through `render` when `partial` is set, else
`page`), `form_invalid` (422), and `form_valid` (raises `HxRedirectIntoFragment` if Django's redirect would
answer a partial request; override it to return `render`/`fragment`/`removed` for element-targeted forms).

### Settings

| Setting | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `HX_MESSAGES_TEMPLATE = "layout.html#messages"` | Partial used to render pending `django.contrib.messages` into fragment responses. `#name` defaults to `messages`. Root element must be `id="<name>"`. |
| `HX_REQUEST_TYPE_FALLBACK = "full"` | Answer htmx requests missing `HX-Request-Type` as this type instead of raising. Proxies only. |
| `HX_LINT_IGNORE = ("implicit-inheritance",)` | Lint rules to silence everywhere (test client, middleware, `hx_lint`, W005). |
| `HX_EXTENSIONS = ("hx-live",)` | Extensions the pages load, for the lint (also detected from `<script src>`). |
| `SILENCED_SYSTEM_CHECKS = ["dj_hx.W005"]` | Standard Django; the check ids are below. |

### Errors

All subclass `HxError` except `HxRedirectError` (an `AssertionError` from the test client).

| Error | Raised or recorded | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HxPageIntoFragment` | raised by `page()` | page answers an element-targeted request | `hx-target="body"` on the control, or `render(..., partial)` |
| `HxRedirectIntoFragment` | raised by `redirect()` / `HxMixin.form_valid`; recorded by the guard for any other 3xx, including `APPEND_SLASH`'s 301 | 3xx answers an element-targeted request | target body, or return a fragment; match the route's trailing slash (`{% url %}` does) |
| `HxFragmentIntoPage` | recorded by `fragment()` / `text()` | bare fragment answers a boosted or body-targeted request | target an element, or render a page |
| `HxNoSwap` | recorded by the guard | 204 answers a partial request; htmx 4 does not swap | `removed()` + `hx-swap="delete"`, or a fragment |
| `HxBareResponse` | recorded by the guard | a `text/html` 2xx no verb built answers an element-targeted request (`django.shortcuts.render`, `HttpResponse`, `TemplateResponse`) | use a verb, or `HxMixin` on a generic view |
| `HxMessagesUnconfigured` | recorded by the middleware | messages added on a fragment response, `HX_MESSAGES_TEMPLATE` unset | set it |
| `HxProtocolError` | raised by `request_type()`; recorded by the guard | `HX-Request` without `HX-Request-Type` | use htmx 4; `HX_REQUEST_TYPE_FALLBACK` for proxies |
| `HxUnknownPartial` | raised at render | `partial=` names no partial of the template; message lists the ones it defines | write `{% partialdef name inline %}` around the region |
| `HxPartialRootId` | raised at render | a partial used as `<hx-partial>` does not start with one element carrying `id="<name>"` | wrap the region in `<div id="name">` |
| `HxLintError` | raised by `HxTestClient` | an error-level lint finding in a `text/html` response | fix the HTML; `lint_ignore=` / `HX_LINT_IGNORE` to silence a rule |
| `HxRedirectError` | raised by `HxTestClient` | 3xx to a `full=True` request without `follow=` | pass `follow=True` (what the browser shows) or `follow=False` (assert on the 3xx) |

## Templates

A page defines its fragments inline. `inline` renders the region in place on the page; the handler
names it to render it alone.

```django
{% extends "layout.html" %}
{% block content %}
<table><tbody>
{% partialdef rows inline %}
{% for contact in contacts %}
<tr>
  <td>{{ contact.first }}</td>
  <td><a href="#" hx-delete="{% url 'contacts_view' contact.id %}"
                  hx-confirm="Delete?" hx-target="closest tr" hx-swap="delete swap:1s">Delete</a></td>
</tr>
{% endfor %}
{% endpartialdef %}
</tbody></table>

{% partialdef count inline %}<span id="count">{{ contacts|length }}</span>{% endpartialdef %}

<span id="total" hx-get="{% url 'contacts_count' %}" hx-trigger="revealed, contacts-changed from:body"></span>
{% endblock %}
```

A form region for `invalid()`:

```django
{% partialdef form inline %}
<form id="form" action="{% url 'contacts_new' %}" method="post">
  {% csrf_token %}
  <input name="email" value="{{ contact.email }}"
         hx-get="{% url 'contacts_email' contact.id %}" hx-target="next .error"
         hx-trigger="change, keyup delay:200ms changed">
  <span class="error">{{ contact.errors.email }}</span>
  <button>Save</button>
</form>
{% endpartialdef %}
```

A button whose response is a page (a redirect after delete from an edit page):

```django
<button hx-delete="{% url 'contacts_view' contact.id %}" hx-target="body" hx-push-url="true">Delete</button>
```

htmx 4 rules the templates rely on (verified against htmx.js 4.0.0):

- `HX-Request-Type` is `full` when the target is `body` or `hx-select` is set or the element is boosted.
- Attributes reach descendants only with `:inherited` (`hx-target:inherited`, `hx-boost:inherited`).
- `hx-delete` sends its parameters in the query string and excludes the enclosing form unless
  `hx-include="closest form"`; the handler reads them from `request.GET`.
- A `delete` swap runs regardless of response content and honors `swap:1s`.
- Only 204 and 304 skip the swap. A 422 body swaps.
- `hx-push-url="true"` pushes the URL after a redirect, so a plain 303 updates the location bar.
- Events are colon-separated (`hx-on::after:swap`, `htmx:after:swap`); modifiers are `from:body`,
  `delay:200ms`, `changed`, `once`, `throttle:1s`; swap styles are case-sensitive (`outerHTML`).

## htmx 2 is rejected

Agents default to htmx 1/2. These are what the lint reports (`[error]` raises in tests):

| Do not write | Write | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `hx-ext="..."` | nothing; loading the extension script is enough | `htmx2-attribute` |
| `hx-vars`, `hx-params`, `hx-disinherit`, `hx-inherit`, `hx-request`, `hx-history`, `hx-disabled-elt` | `hx-vals='js:...'`, `htmx:config:request`, `:inherited`, `hx-config`, `hx-disable` | `htmx2-attribute` |
| `<body hx-boost="true">`, `<div hx-target="#x">` over children | `hx-boost:inherited="true"`, `hx-target:inherited="#x"` | `implicit-inheritance` (warning) |
| `hx-on::afterSwap`, `htmx:afterRequest`, `htmx:configRequest` | `hx-on::after:swap`, `htmx:after:request`, `htmx:config:request` | `htmx2-event-name` |
| `hx-swap="outerhtml"` | `hx-swap="outerHTML"` | `swap-style-case` |
| `hx-swap="innerHTML show:#x:top"` | `hx-swap="innerHTML show:top showTarget:#x"` | `swap-show-syntax` |
| `hx-trigger="click queue:all"` | `hx-sync="this:queue all"` | `trigger-queue` |
| `hx-trigger="click from:closest form"` | `hx-trigger="click from:'closest form'"` | `trigger-unquoted-selector` |
| `hx-delete` with the default swap on `closest tr` | `hx-swap="delete"` or `outerHTML` | `delete-default-swap` (warning) |
| `hx-target="#nope"` with no such id on the page | an existing id | `missing-target` |
| two elements with the same `id` | unique ids | `duplicate-id` |
| `hx-select="#main"` with a non-body target | let the server send the fragment | `select-not-body` (info) |

Also `unknown-attribute`, `unknown-swap-style`, `unknown-swap-modifier`, `unknown-trigger-modifier`,
`trigger-syntax`, `extension-not-loaded` (warning), `delete-without-include` (info). Each message suggests
the nearest valid name.

## Testing

```python
from dj_hx.testing import HxTestClient, assert_no_hx_check_issues

client = HxTestClient()                       # strict=True, lint=True, lint_ignore=()
client.get("/contacts/")                      # a browser
client.hx_get("/contacts/?q=a")               # HX-Request: true, HX-Request-Type: partial
client.hx_get("/contacts/", full=True)        # a boosted link or body-targeted control
client.hx_post("/contacts/new/", {"email": "x"})            # partial: expect 422 or a fragment
client.hx_post("/contacts/new/", form, full=True, follow=True)   # what the browser shows after the 303
client.hx_delete("/contacts/3/", full=True, follow=False)   # assert on the 303 itself
client.hx_delete("/contacts/?selected_contact_ids=1")       # DELETE params go in the query string
client.hx_put("/x/", {"a": 1})                # form-encoded; json={...} sends application/json

def test_dj_hx_is_configured():
    assert_no_hx_check_issues()               # pytest never runs system checks; this does
```

What the client enforces on every request, including plain `client.get`:

- Recorded findings (the verbs' and the guard's) raise the first one. `HxTestClient(strict=False)` records
  instead.
- Every `text/html` response is linted; an error-level finding raises `HxLintError`, a warning is a
  `HxLintWarning` (`warnings.warn`). `lint=False` or `lint_ignore=("rule",)` per client.
- A 3xx to a `full=True` request raises `HxRedirectError` unless `follow=True` or `follow=False` was
  chosen, because htmx's fetch follows redirects and the browser never sees the 3xx.
- Without `HxMiddleware` installed the client runs the guard itself.

Assertions that match the protocol:

```python
r = client.hx_delete("/contacts/3/")                       # a row's link, hx-swap="delete"
assert r.status_code == 200 and b"<tr>" not in r.content
assert r.content.decode().startswith('\n<hx-partial hx-target="#messages" hx-swap="outerHTML">')

r = client.hx_delete("/contacts/?selected_contact_ids=1&selected_contact_ids=2")
assert json.loads(r["HX-Trigger"]) == {"contacts-changed": {"target": "body"}}

with pytest.raises(HxPageIntoFragment, match=r"contacts_view\(\) renders the page"):
    client.hx_get("/contacts/3/")                          # a page-only view reached by a partial control
```

## Tools and checks

```
manage.py hx_lint [paths...] [--warnings-as-errors]   # htmx 4 lint over template source, never site-packages
manage.py hx_map [--no-check] [--by-template]          # controls <-> views <-> events, checked
```

`--by-template` inverts the map: every template and partial a view names, who renders it, and the
controls that reach them.

`hx_map` classifies each control as full or partial by htmx 4's rule, resolves it through `{% url %}` or
the literal path, and errors when a partial control reaches a view that only calls `page`, or a full
control reaches one that only calls `fragment`/`text`/`removed`. `if request.method == "DELETE":` branches
are attributed to that method. It pairs `.trigger("x")` with `hx-trigger="x from:body"` both ways and warns
on `hx-delete` controls that send no values to a handler that reads them.

System checks (tag `dj_hx`):

| ID | Fires when |
|---|---|
| W001 | `HxMiddleware` not installed |
| E002 | `HxMiddleware` listed before `MessageMiddleware` |
| W003 | `django.contrib.messages` installed but `HX_MESSAGES_TEMPLATE` unset |
| W004 | `HX_MESSAGES_TEMPLATE` does not resolve to a template partial |
| W005 | a project template fails the lint |
| W006 | Django < 6 without django-template-partials |
| E007 | a Django base class listed before `HxMixin` shadows its hooks |

`HxMiddleware` also: adds `Vary` to every response, runs the guard, bridges pending messages onto partial
2xx HTML responses (peeking before consuming), logs findings as warnings on the `dj_hx` logger, and under
`DEBUG` lints every htmx response and sets `X-HX-Template`.

## A resource end to end

Function views, abridged from the example app (*Hypermedia Systems*' contact.app on the ORM):

```python
from django.contrib import messages
from django.views.decorators.http import require_http_methods
from dj_hx import invalid, page, redirect, removed, render, text, wants_page

@require_http_methods(["GET", "DELETE"])
def contacts(request):
    if request.method == "DELETE":                       # bulk delete: hx-include="closest form"
        for contact_id in request.GET.getlist("selected_contact_ids"):
            Contact.find(contact_id).delete()
        messages.success(request, "Deleted Contacts!")
        return render(request, "index.html", "rows", {"contacts": Contact.all(1)}).trigger("contacts-changed")
    q = request.GET.get("q")
    contacts_set = Contact.search(q) if q is not None else Contact.all(int(request.GET.get("page", 1)))
    return render(request, "index.html", "rows", {"contacts": contacts_set})

def contacts_count(request):
    return text(request, f"({Contact.count()} total Contacts)")

@require_http_methods(["GET", "POST"])
def contacts_new(request):
    if request.method == "GET":
        return page(request, "new.html", {"contact": Contact()})
    c = Contact(first=request.POST["first_name"], last=request.POST["last_name"], email=request.POST["email"])
    if not c.validate():
        return invalid(request, "new.html", "form", {"contact": c})
    c.save()
    messages.success(request, "Created New Contact!")
    return redirect(request, "contacts")

@require_http_methods(["GET", "DELETE"])
def contacts_view(request, contact_id):
    contact = Contact.find(contact_id)
    if request.method == "DELETE":
        contact.delete()
        messages.success(request, "Deleted Contact!")
        if wants_page(request):          # the edit page's button targets the body
            return redirect(request, "contacts")
        return removed(request)          # a row's link says hx-swap="delete"
    return page(request, "show.html", {"contact": contact})

def contacts_email(request, contact_id):   # inline validation into <span class="error">
    c = Contact.find(contact_id)
    c.email = request.GET.get("email", "")
    c.validate()
    return text(request, c.errors.get("email", ""))
```

```python
urlpatterns = [
    path("contacts/", views.contacts, name="contacts"),
    path("contacts/count/", views.contacts_count, name="contacts_count"),
    path("contacts/new/", views.contacts_new, name="contacts_new"),
    path("contacts/<int:contact_id>/", views.contacts_view, name="contacts_view"),
    path("contacts/<int:contact_id>/email/", views.contacts_email, name="contacts_email"),
]
```

Trailing slashes matter: a control whose URL misses one gets `APPEND_SLASH`'s 301, which the guard reports
as `HxRedirectIntoFragment`. Always build URLs with `{% url %}`.

## Files

- [README.md](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/README.md): the design, the vocabulary, the silent-failure catalogue
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release notes
- [dj_hx/verbs.py](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/dj_hx/verbs.py): the verbs and `HxResponse`
- [dj_hx/request.py](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/dj_hx/request.py): `HX-Request-Type` and the `wants_*` helpers
- [dj_hx/guard.py](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/dj_hx/guard.py): the recorded findings
- [dj_hx/middleware.py](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/dj_hx/middleware.py): `HxMiddleware`
- [dj_hx/messages.py](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/dj_hx/messages.py): the messages bridge
- [dj_hx/mixins.py](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/dj_hx/mixins.py): `HxMixin`
- [dj_hx/testing.py](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/dj_hx/testing.py): `HxTestClient`, `assert_no_hx_check_issues`
- [dj_hx/checks.py](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/dj_hx/checks.py): W001 to E007
- [dj_hx/errors.py](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/dj_hx/errors.py): every exception
- [dj_hx/hxlint.py](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/dj_hx/hxlint.py): the htmx 4 lint (vendored from hx-flask)
- [dj_hx/hx_vocab.py](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/blob/main/dj_hx/hx_vocab.py): the htmx 4.0.0 vocabulary, generated
- [example/](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/tree/main/example): contact.app on the ORM, the complete reference project
- [tests/](https://github.com/codetalcott/dj-hx/tree/main/tests): one test per row of the failure catalogue
